data.name: Fulviah
data.gender_notes: Fulviah is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'fulvus', meaning 'rich in gold'. In Greek mythology, Fulviah was the name of a nymph who protected the olive trees, symbolizing abundance and prosperity. The name Fulviah carries the meaning “Rich in gold” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fulviah usually hope their child will grow to embody rich in gold and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Fulviah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rich in gold.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fulviah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fulviah represents wealth and abundance, originating from the Greek word 'fulvus'. Historically, this name would have been associated with the prosperity of the olive crops and green lands, felt strongly within Christian communities with Mediterranean roots.
data.spiritual_significance: Fulviah symbolizes the bountiful blessings of God, representing the richness of His divine care and providence. Christians who bear the name Fulviah are often encouraged to reflect on the abundance and generosity of God, and strive to live in gratitude towards Him for His many blessings. Additionally, the name Fulviah can be seen as a reminder of the olives tree mentioned in the Bible, which represented peace between God and humanity (Genesis 8:11), further emphasizing the spiritual and symbolic significance of the name.
